label: L=3 copy outputs 2-3, plus early-position q input
explanation: Two disjoint components. (1) Copy phase of length-3 sequences (t=4,5, outputting original tokens 1 and 2): ~69% of activation mass and all of the strongest activations (top examples are all L=3, largest when the fed-back input is 1, s, or p); 85% precision. (2) Weak firing in the original phase at t=1 or 2, concentrated on input q (11x lift), with smaller tails on s, 1, i, x; this part is low magnitude and token-dependent. Never fires at t=0, the delimiter step, or at t>=6, and essentially never in copy phase for L>=4. The predicate misses the low-magnitude non-q original-phase firing (about 10% of mass).
